Every shot matters. Every position matters. It's the playoffs.

#PGATour #FedExCup

stories.title: LIV Golf in Crisis — $40M Finale Canceled, New Investor Announced

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf has canceled its $40M season finale in Michigan.

It's the second event canceled this season. PIF is pulling its funding after 2026. And yet the CEO is also announcing a new investor.

The most chaotic chapter in LIV Golf history is happening right now.

#LIVGolf

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
"LIV 2.0" per CEO Scott O'Neil:

• 5 team majors + 5 U.S.-based team signature events
• LIV players would become majority equity holders
• New lead investor secured (identity undisclosed)
• Deal to close in September

Historic or desperate? Both can be true.

#LIVGolf

article.headline: LIV Golf Cancels $40M Season Finale, Loses Saudi Funding — But CEO Announces New Investor in "LIV 2.0" Pitch

research.facts:
LIV Golf Crisis / New Investor
**HIGH confidence:**
- LIV Golf canceled $40M Michigan team championship [Golf Digest, Front Office Sports, Yahoo Sports]
- Venue of canceled event: The Cardinal at Saint John's Resort, suburban Detroit [Golf Digest]
- Scheduled dates of canceled event: Aug 27-30 [Golf Digest, Front Office Sports]
- Second 2026 cancellation: New Orleans $30M event scrapped in June [Front Office Sports, Yahoo Sports]

- Transaction expected to finalize September 2026 [Forbes, ESPN]
- 2026 LIV season concludes at The Club at Chatham Hills, Westfield, Indiana [Golf Digest]

stories.title: Shiho Kuwaki Wins AIG Women's Open — Japan's First Major Champion of 2026

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
Shiho Kuwaki won the AIG Women's Open.

Her first LPGA Tour win.
Her first major.
In only her SEVENTH major start.

At Royal Lytham. In a two-hole playoff. At the 50th edition of the tournament.

Japanese women's golf is rising.

#LPGA #WomensOpen

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
How it ended at Royal Lytham:

Esther Henseleit holes a monster birdie on 72 to force a playoff.
Shiho Kuwaki wins on the second playoff hole.

One of the more dramatic major finishes of 2026. What a tournament.

#LPGA #WomensOpen
